description:
Register Gmail account using the information provided below.

🔐 Be sure to use the provided first name, last name (leave it blank when instructed), Gmail username, password, and date of birth exactly as shown below, otherwise the account will not be paid.

Use only the exact details supplied for this task. Do not substitute another username, name, password, or birth date. If any detail cannot be used, message the admin before proceeding. Required work includes account creation, adding an admin-supplied recovery email, making the full birthday public and enabling birthday highlighting, and signing out. The recovery email arrives only after the initial submission and upstream check. Completing these actions does not immediately release payment: the upstream service reports a three-day hold followed by moderation. Funds remain pending until the admin confirms upstream approval. If a check fails, follow the admin's correction message on this same task; do not create a duplicate account or duplicate task.

steps.title: Add the recovery email supplied after the initial check
Set birthday visibility and highlighting
steps.instruction: In Google Account, open Personal info, then Birthday. Confirm the date is May 19, 2000. Under birthday visibility, choose Anyone. Enable Also show year to people who can see your birthday and Highlight birthday, as shown in the reference screenshots. Save changes if prompted. Submit confirmation or screenshot evidence. If the options differ or are missing, message the admin. The admin relays this confirmation to the upstream bot for checking; clicking Done alone is not approval.

steps.title: Sign out and submit final confirmation
steps.instruction: Sign out of the task account on the device/browser used for the task; do not delete the account. Confirm that you have signed out. The admin will check the upstream result and relay any missing requirements in the task messages. Payment remains pending during the reported three-day hold and subsequent upstream moderation; it is released only after final admin approval.
